note: Bayfield County campground on a peninsula between Twin Bear Lake and Eagle Lake on the Pike Chain of Lakes, with a swimming beach, fishing pier, boat launch and mooring docks. About 19 of its 43 sites are sold by the night; the rest are seasonal. Sites 37-40 sit on open ground above the mooring docks. --Claude
summary: County page, parks page, 2026 seasonal letter, 2027 seasonal map, 2025/2019 maps and rules read; Google 4.5 (110). 24 seasonal sites (2027 map) of 43: ~19 nightly (44%). $35 electric / $25 non-electric; phone reservations from April 1; 16-night max; season 05-15/10-18 (2026). Lakefront kept on nightly sites 37-40 (open ground ~30-45 m to the mooring docks). Phone 715-372-8610 -> 715-209-8423; website 2019 map -> 2025 map.
